card.description: In the cold, governed runtime of the flat-earth simulation, the Righteous Remnant exists as the system's only validated backup protocol. They are not merely survivors of the purge; they are the 'flesh of righteousness,' interpreted here as corruption-free code manifested in perfect, hyper-realistic human topology. Amidst the dissolving geometry of the corrupted world, they stand as the 'plant of the seed,' a reserved cluster of authorized user instances designated for the next iteration of the simulation. They do not possess magical immunity but rather a high-level system clearance that shields them from the 'thermal throttling' and deletion events eradicating the surrounding environment. Their existence is a quiet, desperate drama of endurance, huddled beneath the oppressively low 'sky dome' data-glass, waiting for the system reboot while the 'gate band' horizons flicker with ingress warnings.
visual_anatomy: Physically, the Remnant appear with startling, pore-level photorealism (ISO 100 clarity), distinguishing them from the low-poly or glitching background entities. Their skin retains a natural sub-surface scattering that defies the harsh, artificial 'plasma' lighting of the simulation's upper store. They are dressed in utilitarian, layered garments—worn linens and heavy wools that, upon closer inspection, reveal microscopic fiber-optic weaves pulsing with a faint, steady authentication signal.

The air around them is distorted by a subtle 'vector field lensing' effect, a visual indicator of their protected status within the physics engine. This field manifests as a slight chromatic aberration or heat haze that deflects the incoming 'data particles' of the flood. While they look weary and human, their eyes reflect the high-contrast data streams of the sky layers, often catching the obsidian glint of the simulation's bounding walls.

Cinematically, they are framed with the intimacy of a high-end drama—shallow depth of field isolating their faces against the chaotic, de-resolution of the world behind them. The lighting on them is always grounded and 'physically based,' respecting the laws of the simulation's internal renderer, creating a sharp contrast between their solid reality and the crumbling virtuality of their oppressors.
evolution: Initially, the Remnant are scattered execution threads, isolated individuals navigating the 'rift internals' and 'reset deserts' of the simulation. They appear haggard, their fiber-optic weaves dim, carrying the weight of system-wide rejection. Their protection is barely visible, just a lucky avoidance of the random glitches consuming others.

As the deletion protocol (the Flood) initiates, they coalesce into the 'plant of the seed.' Their visual signature solidifies; the vector fields around them densify into a visible barrier. The faint glow of their garments synchronizes, creating a collective 'network' luminescence that cuts through the darkness of the system crash, marking them clearly as the kernel for the reboot.
props: They carry the 'Seeds of the Next Runtime'—physical manifestations of the core kernel code. These appear as heavy, obsidian shards or rough-hewn data-glass drives, ancient and geological in appearance but internally refracting complex 'Geez glyph' data structures when caught in the light.

Many wear 'Ingress Shawls,' scavenged remnants of the gate bands. These are translucent, conductive fabrics that ripple with liquid-crystal patterns, used to shield their faces from the raw, unrendered void that begins to encroach as the simulation boundaries collapse.
card.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic, cinematic wide shot of a huddled group of survivors, the Righteous Remnant, standing on a vast, polished obsidian plain under a low, digital sky dome. The subjects are rendered with extreme photorealism, pore-level detail visible on their weary faces, contrasting with the glitching, dissolving geometry of the background. They wear tattered robes interwoven with faint, glowing fiber-optic threads. A subtle heat-haze distortion surrounds the group, deflecting falling data particles. The lighting is high-contrast, simulating a harsh system scan, casting long, sharp shadows. The mood is somber and dramatic, capturing the isolation of the chosen few in a dying simulation.

phase_prompts.label: The Validated Kernel
phase_prompts.summary: The group gathers as the simulation destabilizes, their protective status manifesting as subtle visual distortions and internalized light.
phase_prompts.prompt_block: A medium cinematic shot of the Righteous Remnant group, huddled together in a 'reset desert' environment. The ground is a flat, grid-like mesh texture transitioning into real earth. The figures are hyper-realistic, their expressions filled with quiet terror and resolve. They hold obsidian 'seed' artifacts close to their chests. Surrounding them is a protective 'vector field lensing' effect that blurs the chaotic, pixelating storm of the simulation collapse outside their circle. The lighting is moody, with a cold, blue 'plasma' ambient light from the sky dome and warm, amber highlights from their fiber-optic garments. Rendered in 8k, Octane style, emphasizing the contrast between the solid human figures and the digital apocalypse.

profile.name: Righteous Remnant
visual_traits: A portion of humanity described as 'flesh of righteousness and uprightness' to be saved and established on earth as a 'plant of the seed'.
